Our services

Lawn care and pest control, tailored to you

Whether you’re looking to have some stubborn weeds eliminated or some fertilizer added to give your lawn a nice pop, we have you covered. Maybe you’re having issues with mice getting into your house or wasps nests in your yard. We have you covered — and if you don’t see a specific service listed, just reach out and ask!

Lawn Fertilization

Fertilizer added to give your lawn a nice pop — part of our extensive list of lawn care services, tailored to your needs.

Grub Control & Prevention

Preventative grub control and treatments — stop grubs before they damage your lawn.

Weed Elimination & Crabgrass Prevention

Stubborn weeds eliminated, plus crabgrass prevention treatments — and vegetation and bed weed control.

Tick Control

Tick control for your yard — so your family can enjoy the lawn without the worry. We specialize in minor cases or infestations.

Bee & Wasp Removal

Bee removal and wasp removal — including wasps nests in your yard, handled by our team.

Spider Control & De-Webbing

Spider control and de-webbing, plus exterior treatments and exclusion to keep pests out of your house.

About us

A story of passion and expertise

LawnBugs LLC is proud to be a minority woman-owned business specializing in providing top-tier lawn care and pest control services. With a dedicated team, we take pride in our ability to transform lawns and create pest-free environments for our valued customers. Our story is one of passion and expertise, driven by the desire to make a difference in the community.

What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Without our customers, there is no company.

  • Aeration, overseeding, slit seeding & soil testing
  • Sod webworm, chinchbug, cutworm & weevil treatments
  • Mosquito stations & exterior treatments
  • Exclusion — keeping mice out of your house
Meet the team

The couple behind LawnBugs

Eme Bunce

Founder, Owner & Office Administrator

The woman behind the company, Eme manages all of the day-to-day operations within the office. She has worked in the customer service industry for 15 years and takes great pride in her ability to connect with people — making it her top priority to ensure customers are more than satisfied.

Dylan Bunce

Founder, Operator

With 10 years of experience in the lawn care and pest control industry combined, Dylan is the reason LawnBugs was created. His passion for agronomy (lawns) and entomology (bugs) blossomed early on in his career. You got a lawn? He’s got you covered. You got bugs? He’s got THEM covered!
